author: Ari Koslow
title: Chase Petty recalled from Triple-A
desc: The Reds recalled Chase Petty from Triple-A Louisville.
impact: Petty will add a fresh arm for the Reds heading into Sunday's final game before the All-Star break.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Nick Lodolo (blister) placed on IL
desc: The Reds placed Nick Lodolo on the 15-day injured list.
impact: Lodolo left his latest start early with a blister. He'll be sidelined for at least the next couple of weeks.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Bo Bichette (leg/ankle) not in lineup Sunday
desc: Bo Bichette is not in the Mets lineup on Sunday against the Red Sox.
impact: Bichette is sitting for a third straight game. He'll look to use the All-Star break to get fully healthy.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jordan Montgomery (elbow) sent on rehab assignment Sunday
desc: The Rangers sent Jordan Montgomery on a rehab assignment to Triple-A Round Rock.
impact: Montgomery will make his next rehab start in Triple-A on Sunday.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Cody Bradford (elbow) sent on rehab assignment to Double-A
desc: The Rangers sent Cody Bradford on a rehab assignment to Double-A Frisco.
impact: Bradford will make a rehab start for Double-A Frisco on Sunday.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Chris Martin (shoulder) placed on IL
desc: The Rangers placed Chris Martin on the 15-day injured list with a right shoulder impingement.
impact: Martin returns to the IL just one week after he returned from a stint on the injured list with a shoulder injury. He'll likely be sidelined through the remainder of July.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Emiliano Teodo recalled from Triple-A
desc: The Rangers recalled Emiliano Teodo from Triple-A Round Rock.
impact: Teodo will slide into a middle-relief role in the bullpen for Texas.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Cristopher Sanchez to start for NL in All-Star game
desc: Cristopher Sanchez has been announced as the starter for the National League in the All-Star game.
impact: Sanchez enters the break second in wins (11) and third in strikeouts (144) in the majors. He'll be starting in his home ball park.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Spencer Steer generating trade interest
desc: Spencer Steer is reportedly generating trade interest.
impact: Steer is hitting .244 on the season with 14 home runs and 36 RBI. He'll be a player to monitor over the next few weeks.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Lourdes Gurriel Jr. drawing trade interest from Phillies
desc: The Phillies have expressed interest in Lourdes Gurriel Jr.
impact: Gurriel is hitting just .216 on the season with two home runs and 20 RBI across 167 at-bats. He'll remain a name to monitor over the next few weeks.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Brendan Donovan (groin) expected to begin rehab assignment in next few days
desc: Brendan Donovan is expected to begin his rehab assignment in the next few days.
impact: Donovan had been expected to begin a rehab assignment earlier in July. He'll likely be looking at a return in late July or early August.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Julio Rodriguez (concussion) hopeful to return after All-Star break
desc: Julio Rodriguez is hopeful to be activated from the concussion injured list after the All-Star break.
impact: Rodriguez has continued to work out  in Seattle. He could be available to return next weekend.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Danny Coulombe designated for assignment
desc: The Red Sox designated Danny Coulombe for assignment.
impact: Coulombe loses his spot on the 40-man roster for Boston. He will head to waivers.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Nick Sogard activated from IL, optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Red Sox activated Nick Sogard from the injured list and optioned him to Triple-A.
impact: Sogard makes his way back from an oblique injury. He will remain in Triple-A.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Brayan Bello recalled from Triple-A
desc: The Red Sox recalled Brayan Bello from Triple-A.
impact: Bello will fill a role in the bullpen for the final game before the All-Star break.
